testcase.name: invalid numerical input cannot poison later finite estimates
stale samples do not create spikes
out of order speed cannot replace the derivative baseline
recommended curve speed is rounded to 5 kph
no speed means no lateral g
duplicate and very fast samples do not replace the derivative baseline
longitudinal g comes from speed deltas and is smoothed
total g combines lateral and longitudinal
both source directions discard offset and start the next derivative from the new source
lateral g follows v2 times curvature with wheelbase 2_9 m and ratio 15
a source change inside the minimum derivative interval still establishes its own baseline
brake pedal percentage refines braking when larger than dv dt
independent brake percentage estimate remains available on a speed source handoff
reordered or invalid other source cannot reset the valid source baseline
location speed estimator derives speed from consecutive fixes
